preset.label: Chatterbox Voice Swap
preset.source: Comfy UI Ideas doc, Audio: dialogue, option B (voice conversion). ChatterboxVC from ComfyUI-ChatterboxTTS (installed), zero-shot.
preset.description: Record a line yourself with the exact performance you want, then swap only the voice (Chatterbox voice conversion, no training): timing, pitch, slurring and emphasis carry over. Only use voices you have permission to use.

likeness.label: Voice likeness
likeness.info: How closely it copies the target voice. Higher sounds more like the target but can lose naturalness; 0.7 is the default.

passes.label: Passes
passes.info: Runs the conversion again on its own result to move further toward the target voice. More than 3 or so starts to distort.

steps.label: Steps
steps.info: Refinement passes inside each conversion. 10 is the default; more is slower and only slightly cleaner.

vram.basis: Chatterbox S3Gen + voice encoder (as the Chatterbox TTS preset)

info.audio: Your recording: the line performed the way you want it (record it with the Record button, dry, in a quiet room). Target voice: 5-15 s of clean speech in the voice to end up with.
